result.summary: The page mostly renders correctly, but there is a clearly broken discount badge on the second 'Popular right now' card and an inconsistent favorite-button style between cards. A few minor visual inconsistencies also appear in the 'Fastest near you' carousel.

issues.description: The second restaurant card in 'Popular right now' shows a discount badge reading '-0%', which communicates no discount at all and looks like a data/formatting bug.
issues.suggestion: Hide the discount badge when the discount value is zero or null, and only render it for values greater than 0.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) button styling is inconsistent between the two 'Popular right now' cards: the first uses a white circle with a dark outline heart, the second uses a dark/translucent circle with a white heart.
issues.suggestion: Apply one consistent favorite button style (background, icon color, size) across all restaurant cards.

issues.description: The 'Green Bowl Poké' thumbnail in the 'Fastest near you' row has a light grey background while the neighbouring thumbnails are dark, making the row look visually uneven and the white time pill harder to read.
issues.suggestion: Normalize thumbnail treatment (e.g., add a consistent dark gradient overlay behind the time pill) so all cards in the carousel match.

issues.description: The 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card shows a '€0 delivery' badge on the image and repeats '€0 delivery' in the metadata line directly below, duplicating the same information.
issues.suggestion: Show the free-delivery indicator in only one location, either the image badge or the metadata row.
